Link cell shape and gene expression via Canonical Correlation Analysis

Source: R/link_shape_and_factors.r
link_shape_and_factors.Rd

Runs CCA between a shape PC matrix and an expression factor matrix. Operates on a single pre-filtered cell set. For multi-group workflows, call this function once per group in an external loop, passing pre-subsetted matrices each time.

link_shape_and_factors(
  obj,
  expr_mat,
  shape_mat,
  min_cells = 100,
  scale = TRUE,
  test_significance = FALSE,
  nperm = 1000L,
  perm_seed = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  return_results = TRUE,
  output_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat v5 object. Used only to validate that matrix row names match known cell names; never mutated.

expr_mat

Numeric matrix (cells x features). Expression-side input, e.g. NMF factor scores. Row names must match Seurat cell names.

shape_mat

Numeric matrix (cells x shape PCs). Shape-side input from TPCA. Row names must match Seurat cell names.

min_cells

Integer. If fewer cells remain after intersecting the three cell sets, the function errors (default 100).

scale

Logical. Whether to z-score shape_mat and expr_mat before CCA (default TRUE).

test_significance

Logical. Whether to compute deflation-based permutation p-values via cca_pvalues() (default FALSE).

nperm

Integer. Number of permutations for significance testing.

perm_seed

Integer or NULL. RNG seed for permutation testing.

verbose

Logical. Whether to emit progress messages (default FALSE).

return_results

Logical. When TRUE (default) the result list is returned. When FALSE, the result is serialized to <output_dir>/all.rds and the file path is returned.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Directory for serialized output when return_results = FALSE. When NULL a temporary directory is used and not cleaned up. Ignored when return_results = TRUE.

Value

When return_results = TRUE: a list containing CC_Corr_Coefs, Shape_Corr_With_CSP, Exp_Corr_With_CEP, CSP_Scores, CEP_Scores, CSP_Vectors, CEP_Vectors, Misc_CCA, and Anchor_Features. If test_significance = TRUE, also P_Value_Info.

When return_results = FALSE: a list with element output_path (character scalar, path to the serialized RDS).

See also

store_kstitch_results, load_kstitch_results
